verdict.rationale: Docs show billing insights, usage breakdowns, and FOCUS API export (coreweave-docs-13, coreweave-docs-34) plus pay-as-you-go on-demand/spot pricing (coreweave-docs-20, coreweave-docs-35), implying usage-based billing, but none explicitly state per-second or per-minute billing granularity tied strictly to instance runtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of billing increment (per-second/per-minute), confirmation that billing stops immediately when instance is terminated, and independent/community verification of billing granularity.
